results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Discover accessible properties using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES (select one exact returned siteUrl, or confirm a provided one, and reuse it for all downstream calls).
[Optional (if access level is unclear)] [Prerequisite]: Validate the chosen property using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_GET_SITE (confirm permissionLevel before larger pulls).
[Required] [Step]: Review sitemap inventory/health using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITEMAPS (use GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_GET_SITEMAP only to drill into one sitemap with warnings/errors/pending).

[Required] [Step]: Pull overall performance totals/trends using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY (use a stable reporting window; if results truncate, paginate with start_row/row_limit and aggregate).

[Optional (if ranked breakouts are needed)] [Step]: Re-run GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY with dimensions (for example query/page/date/device/country/searchAppearance); aggregate by rows[].keys and use COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH if the row set is too large to summarize inline.
[Optional (if diagnosing a specific URL)] [Next Step]: Diagnose indexing/canonical outcomes using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_INSPECT_URL (inspection_url must belong to the selected siteUrl property).

[Optional (for write operations only, with explicit confirmation)] [Next Step]: Resubmit a sitemap using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SUBMIT_SITEMAP (use a sitemap path/identifier returned by GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITEMAPS and confirm it matches the property).

[Fallback (if GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY fails with HTTP 400 invalidParameter)] [Fallback]: Retry GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY with a compatible aggregation_type (and simplify dimensions if needed).
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES] Properties may include multiple variants (domain vs URL-prefix); siteUrl must match the returned value exactly or results can be empty/partial.
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITEMAPS] Count-like fields (submitted/indexed/errors/warnings) may arrive as strings; cast before numeric comparisons or aggregation.
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY] Dimensioned responses store group-by values in rows[].keys (array) whose length varies with dimensions; don’t assume a fixed shape.
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY] Returning exactly row_limit rows can indicate truncation even without an error; totals can be understated if not paginated.

[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SUBMIT_SITEMAP] Requests can fail validation if the required sitemap path field is missing or misnamed, and can return HTTP 400 invalidParameter for an incompatible path—verify the exact identifier via GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITEMAPS before retrying.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Paginate GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY with start_row and merge rows
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
from typing import List, Dict, Any

def fetch_all(run_tool, args: Dict[str, Any], page_size: int = 5000, max_rows: int = 25000) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    rows=[]; start_row=0
    while True:
        a=dict(args); a["row_limit"]=page_size; a["start_row"]=start_row
        resp, err = run_tool("GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY", a)
        if err: raise RuntimeError(err)
        data = resp.get("data", resp)
        page = (data.get("rows") or [])
        rows.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_size or len(rows) >= max_rows: return rows
        start_row += page_size
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Google Search Console provides tools to monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot your site's presence in Google Search results.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=google_search_console. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="google_search_console") to create a connection BEFORE executing any google_search_console tools.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES.description: Lists all verified sites (properties) owned by the authenticated user in Google Search Console. Response contains a siteEntry array — always iterate it, never assume a single object. Each entry includes permissionLevel, which varies per site; do not assume owner-level access for all returned properties. When calling downstream tools, use the site_url value exactly as returned, including protocol, subdomain, sc-domain: prefix, and trailing slash — any deviation causes empty results or permission errors. Empty siteEntry may indicate missing OAuth scopes or no verified properties. Newly added properties may not appear immediately due to propagation delay.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_Q.description: Queries Google Search Console for search analytics data including clicks, impressions, CTR, and position metrics. Only returns URLs with at least one impression; missing rows do not confirm non-indexing. Position is an impression-weighted average rank.

end_date.description: The end date of the date range for the query, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

site_url.description: The site's URL, including protocol (e.g., https://www.example.com/) or a domain property (e.g., sc-domain:example.com). URL-prefix properties specify exact protocol and path, while domain properties aggregate data across all subdomains and protocols.

row_limit.description: The maximum number of rows to return. Must be between 1 and 25,000. Note: The API returns top results sorted by clicks (or date when grouping by date). Must be between 1 and 5000. Use start_row to paginate; stop when response rows < row_limit.

start_row.description: The first row to return from the result set. Used for pagination.

dimensions.description: The dimensions to group the data by. Results are sorted by clicks descending, except when grouping by date (sorted by date ascending).

start_date.description: The start date of the date range for the query, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Data lags 2–3 days (UTC); most recent 1–2 days may be incomplete. Data retention is ~16 months; older ranges return zero rows.

search_type.description: The search type to filter results by.

dimension_filter_groups.description: Optional filters to apply to dimensions. Each filter group contains an array of filters with structure: [{'filters': [{'dimension': 'country', 'operator': 'equals', 'expression': 'USA'}]}]. Operators: equals, notEquals, contains, notContains, includingRegex, excludingRegex. Invalid dimension names, unsupported operators, or mismatched expressions return zero rows without an error — verify each filter before trusting empty results.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_GET_SITE.description: Retrieves information about a specific Search Console site. Use when you need to get site details including permission level for a specific property.

site_url.description: The URL of the property to retrieve, as defined by Search Console. Examples: http://www.example.com/ (for a URL-prefix property) or sc-domain:example.com (for a Domain property).
